Q3. Solve
     2 cos²x + 3cosx - 2 = 0 for 0⁰ ≤ x ≤ 360⁰ ( 6 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
(2cos x − 1)(cos x + 2) = 0
cos x = 1/2 → x = 60°, 300°
cos x = −2 → no solution (|cos x| ≤ 1)
x = 60° or x = 300°

questions.section: PART 2: STRUCTURED QUESTIONS. ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS. (60 Marks)
questions.question:
Q4. If Z = 2 [ cos 30⁰ + i sin 30⁰ ]
   Find
  a) Z³ ( 3marks)
  b) Z⁵ ( 3 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
By De Moivre's theorem:
a) Z³ = 2³(cos 90° + i sin 90°) = 8(0 + i) = 8i
b) Z⁵ = 2⁵(cos 150° + i sin 150°) = 32(−√3/2 + ½ i) = −16√3 + 16i

questions.question:
Q8. The equation of a parabola is y² + 8y + 8 x – 8 = 0
   Compute the
  a) Vertex ( 2 marks)
  b) Focus ( 2 marks)
  c) directrix ( 2 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
Complete the square: (y + 4)² − 16 + 8x − 8 = 0 → (y + 4)² = −8x + 24 = −8(x − 3)
4p = −8 → p = −2 (opens to the left)
a) Vertex = (3, −4)
b) Focus = (3 − 2, −4) = (1, −4)
c) Directrix: x = 3 + 2 → x = 5
